query: Before we commit a year to this product direction, examine the competing theories of user value, technical feasibility and systemic impact, then define what outcomes would prove us wrong.
This investigation has several plausible decompositions and the evidence comes from incompatible time horizons. I need an end-to-end, auditable way through it.
Help us decide whether more research, a small reversible probe, or no action has the highest value given serious uncertainty and affected stakeholders.
Run a proportionate multi-method inquiry and make sure its own method can learn from the eventual outcome.
We may be solving the wrong problem. Stop after mapping alternative constructs, boundaries and scales.
Here are seven method reports; reconcile their conflicts and source dependence, but do not recommend an action.
Implement the accepted API endpoint exactly as specified and run the existing checks.
Audit this completed inquiry independently for missing stakeholders, unsupported scale bridges and premature convergence.
